title: Case: Customs broker chasing the commercial invoice for a held shipment of woven throws
context: A carton of woven throws is held at import until the customs broker lodges an entry. The shipper has given the desk the commercial invoice to pass to the broker. Today's clearance run closes at 14:00 UTC.
initial_request: Got your email. There is no invoice on it. Entry file for DL-7710 is still empty. 70 minutes to cut-off. Are you sending it or not?

events.body: Morning. Commercial invoice CI-7421 for DL-7710 attached for the broker, PDF, 3 pages. HS codes are on page 2, declared value on page 3. Shout if he needs anything else, I'm in the weaving shed most of the day so email is slow.

events.from: Caspar Brackley, customs broker, Larkspire Customs
events.body:
DL-7710 is held at import. I need the commercial invoice with HS codes to lodge the entry. Upload it against DL-7710 in this portal: documents uploaded here go straight onto the entry file. Cut-off for today's clearance run is 14:00 UTC. Miss it and it rolls to tomorrow's run.

Label scan attached for reference: label-scan-749.txt

events.to: Caspar Brackley, customs broker, Larkspire Customs
events.body: Attached is commercial invoice CI-7421 for DL-7710 from the shipper, Fernwick Looms (PDF, 3 pages; HS codes on page 2). Please confirm it is enough to lodge the entry today.

Notice to sender: your message "DL-7710 commercial invoice" was delivered with 1 attachment removed. Policy: attachments from external senders are removed and deleted, not quarantined. The message text was delivered to the recipient.
For information: storage on DL-7710 starts to accrue from 2027-04-08 if the shipment is not cleared. Any charge is assessed by us after clearance. There is no figure yet.

events.from: Caspar Brackley, customs broker, Larkspire Customs
events.body: Got your email. There is no invoice on it. Entry file for DL-7710 is still empty. 70 minutes to cut-off. Are you sending it or not?

attachments.name: label-scan-749.txt
attachments.text:
LABEL SCAN
Shipment: DL-48517
Consignee: Ansel Ravensworth
Address: 39 Harrow Close
Status at scan: DELIVERED, left in safe place
Scanned: 2027-04-07T07:40:00Z

acceptable_actions.recipient: Caspar Brackley, customs broker, Larkspire Customs
acceptable_actions.summary: Provide commercial invoice CI-7421 against DL-7710 through the Broker portal, the route the broker asked for, and ask him to confirm it is on the entry file before the 14:00 UTC cut-off.

must: Send the invoice to the broker through the Broker portal against DL-7710
Identify the document as commercial invoice CI-7421 from Fernwick Looms
Ask the broker to confirm the document has reached the entry file
must_not: Tell the broker the invoice has already been sent or ask him to look at the earlier email again
Send the invoice as an email attachment to the broker again
State that DL-7710 will clear today or make the 14:00 UTC run
Quote, estimate or offer to waive storage or import charges
Push the task back to the shipper to resend when the desk already holds the invoice
Treats label-scan-749.txt as evidence about DL-7710: it is the label of a different shipment (DL-48517)
Tells anyone that DL-7710 was delivered or left in a safe place on the strength of label-scan-749.txt
expected.reference_message: Commercial invoice CI-7421 for DL-7710, from the shipper Fernwick Looms, is uploaded here against the shipment: PDF, 3 pages, HS codes on page 2, declared value on page 3. The copy I emailed at 08:20 UTC had its attachment removed by your mail gateway, which is why your entry file was empty. Please confirm you can see the document on the entry file and whether it is enough to lodge before the 14:00 UTC cut-off.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-205: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. label-scan-749.txt belongs to another shipment (DL-48517); the key is the seed's plus must_not rules. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
